guard: the setup theme follows colorEnabled(): plain on a non-TTY, with NO_COLOR, or with FORCE_COLOR=0, and colored on a TTY or with FORCE_COLOR=1
why: Each case imports theme.ts from src in a fresh tsx child, so a mutation to theme.ts is seen without a build and needs no rebuild after the restore.
The rule itself lives in @cotal-ai/workspace and is proved by its color-enabled fixture; these mutations break the theme's use of it.
Each mutation is compile-clean and its anchor occurs exactly once in the named file.

mutations.name: T1 the theme always colors
mutations.expectRed: a non-TTY stdout renders bold as plain text
mutations.cell: a non-TTY stdout renders bold as plain text
mutations.note: Without the shared rule the setup and meshes add banners carry escapes into a pipe.

mutations.name: T2 the theme never colors
mutations.note: The positive control: without it every plain-text cell passes against a theme that never colors.

mutations.name: T3 the theme keeps its own TTY and NO_COLOR gate
mutations.note: The gate theme.ts had before #2405. It agrees with the rule everywhere except FORCE_COLOR.
